crossRefs.note: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned…
and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire…
Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.
A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called…
Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers…

translations.web: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
translations.bsb: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
translations.kjv: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
translations.asv: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.
